questions.question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
questions.explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”。

questions.question: The marketing team conducted a comprehensive survey to gauge ______ satisfaction.
questions.explanation: 复数名词所有格 clients' 修饰名词 satisfaction。

questions.question: Clients who wish to upgrade their software subscription can do so ______ contacting support.
questions.explanation: by doing sth. 表示“通过……方式”。

questions.question: The newly opened branch office has performed ______ than expected in its first quarter.
questions.explanation: than 提示用比较级 better。

questions.question: Ms. Alvarez will assume the role of director ______ Mr. Vance retires next month.
questions.explanation: 引导时间状语从句用连词 when。

questions.question: All employees are required to wear their identification badges ______ on company premises.
questions.explanation: 副词 always 表示“总是”。

questions.question: The factory manager inspected the production line to ensure safety standards ______ strictly followed.
questions.explanation: 主语 standards 为复数，且陈述客观规定用 are。

questions.question: Please review the attached contract thoroughly before signing and returning ______ to our office.
questions.explanation: 指代单数名词 contract 用宾格代词 it。

questions.question: The company’s quarterly profits rose steadily ______ a slight drop in consumer spending.
questions.explanation: despite 为介词，表让步“尽管”。

questions.question: To improve operational efficiency, the executives decided to ______ the internal workflow.
questions.explanation: to 不定式后接动词原形 streamline。

questions.question: Applicants for the senior accountant position must possess ______ in financial auditing.
questions.explanation: possess 及物动词后接名词 experience（经验）。

questions.question: The board of directors will vote on the proposed merger ______ tomorrow's meeting.
questions.explanation: 在特定会议上用介词 at（at the meeting）。

questions.question: Attendees are encouraged to arrive early ______ they can secure seating near the stage.
questions.explanation: 引导目的状语从句用 so that（以便于）。

questions.question: Ms. Henderson is ______ for coordinating international shipments and customs clearance.
questions.explanation: be responsible for 固定搭配“负责……”。

questions.question: The updated software package includes several features designed to protect user data ______ unauthorized access.
questions.explanation: protect ... from ... 意为“保护……免受……”。

questions.question: The human resources department announced that ______ applicants will be notified by email.
questions.explanation: 形容词 qualified 修饰名词 applicants（合格的申请人）。

questions.question: Mr. Tanaka has been working at the Tokyo branch ______ over ten years.
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段，用于完成时态。

questions.question: The printer in the second-floor office is currently out of order, so please use ______ on the third floor.
questions.explanation: 泛指同类可数单数名词用代词 one。

questions.question: To ensure timely delivery, please submit your order forms ______ than Friday.
questions.explanation: no later than 意为“不迟于……”。

questions.question: The CEO emphasized that teamwork is ______ to the success of our global projects.
questions.explanation: be 动词后作表语用形容词 vital。

questions.question: Mr. Harris ______ the presentation before the clients arrived at the boardroom.
questions.explanation: 过去的过去用过去完成时 had finished。

questions.question: The maintenance crew will inspect the elevators ______ this weekend.
questions.explanation: throughout 表示“在……期间/遍及”。

questions.question: Feedback from our focus groups indicates that customers prefer eco-friendly packaging ______ traditional plastic.
questions.explanation: prefer A to B 意为“比起 B 更喜欢 A”。

questions.question: The financial advisor recommended diversifying our investment portfolio to minimize potential ______.
questions.explanation: minimize 后接复数名词 risks（风险）。

questions.question: ______ the workshop was challenging, the participants gained valuable project management skills.
questions.explanation: 引导让步状语从句用连词 Although。

questions.question: All participants must register ______ for the annual leadership seminar by Friday.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 register 用副词 online。

questions.question: The research division has made significant progress ______ developing renewable energy sources.
questions.explanation: make progress in sth. 意为“在……方面取得进展”。

questions.question: Ms. Lopez spoke ______ about the company’s expansion plans during the press conference.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 spoke 用副词 confidently。

questions.question: The store manager agreed to ______ a full refund for the defective merchandise.
questions.explanation: agree to do sth. 中 to 后接动词原形 issue。

questions.question: To access the restricted archives, employees must enter their secure ______.
questions.explanation: 复数名词 passwords 表示密码。

questions.question: The seminar on effective communication will be held in conference room B ______ 9:00 AM.
questions.explanation: 具体时刻前用介词 at。

questions.question: Our logistics team is currently evaluating several shipping vendors to reduce transportation ______.
questions.explanation: reduce 后接复数名词 costs（成本）。

questions.question: ______ you encounter any technical issues during the installation, please contact IT support.
questions.explanation: 条件句倒装省略 if：Should you encounter ...

questions.question: The promotion campaign generated an ______ number of inquiries from prospective buyers.
questions.explanation: 形容词 unprecedented 修饰名词 number。

questions.question: Mr. Harris decided to postpone his business trip ______ the severe weather warnings.
questions.explanation: due to 后接名词短语表示“由于”。

questions.question: The company offers competitive salaries as well as comprehensive health ______ for all full-time staff.
questions.explanation: health benefits 意为“健康福利”。

questions.question: Staff members are reminded to lock their computer screens ______ they leave their desks.
questions.explanation: 引导时间状语从句“每当……时”用 whenever。

questions.question: The accounting department requires all travel reimbursement forms to be ______ by receipts.
questions.explanation: be accompanied by 意为“随附……”。

questions.question: Please submit your completed application form ______ email to the personnel department.
questions.explanation: by email 意为“通过电子邮件”。
